fact: The World Bank's digital economy assessment states that there is currently no comprehensive digital strategy in the Central African Republic, and that most digital projects are run ad hoc by individual sector ministries (document dated 2020, no month given).

The assessment's SWOT lists a national digital strategy as in preparation, and says the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications commissioned technical assistance to support a comprehensive Digital CAR strategy, with the level of buy-in from other ministries unclear (document dated 2020, no month given).

The assessment says the technical assistance for the Digital CAR strategy is financed under the Central African Backbone project, co-funded by the European Union and the African Development Bank; a feasibility study on the country's digital strategy was launched in 2020 under that project (document dated 2020, no month given).

A workshop on 10-11 November 2021, opened by the chief of staff of the Ministry of Digital Economy, Posts and Telecommunications, presented the studies for the Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2025; no adoption is stated.
The document gives the plan's period as 2020-2025.
The ACDD, created by Loi n° 23.008 of 19 June 2023, states its mission is implementing the national strategy for developing the digital ecosystem.
